### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

|---|---|---|---|
| Standard accelerator investment | $220,000 | $200,000 through an uncapped MFN Safe + $20,000 through a Post-Money Convertible Equity Agreement (CEA). | No partner needed |
| Asia-Pacific accelerator investment | $120,000 | Techstars accelerator programs in Asia-Pacific offer a $100,000 uncapped MFN Safe (so $120,000 total day-one investment alongside the $20K CEA for 5% common). | No partner needed |

### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

This is an equity investment, not a credit: the $220,000 is capital in exchange for 5% common stock plus the future conversion value of the SAFE. The page states "Techstars invests in US corporations or foreign equivalents" and notes reorganisation may be required for certain countries, which is why requires_incorporation is true. Per-accelerator eligibility (sector, stage, location) lives on individual program pages which I did not open, and the application portal was not inspected. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.

| | |
|---|---|

**[Apply →](https://apply.techstars.com/)**

### What they ask of you in return

- Techstars receives 5% of the company in common stock through the $20,000 Post-Money Convertible Equity Agreement
- The $200,000 uncapped MFN SAFE converts when the company does a priced round of at least $1M
- Complete background, incorporation, ownership, IP and company bank account checks before the $20,000 is wired
- Participate in the 3-month mentorship-driven accelerator program
